title: AGENTS.md Example: Rules for Your AI Agent in 5 Lines
description:
Your AI coding agent keeps guessing your commands? Give it an AGENTS.md. ✅

✅ Create AGENTS.md with your build and test commands
✅ Add one style rule and one never rule
✅ Count the lines: short beats long

Day 2 of Spec-Driven AI! Next up, Day 3: Turn a Spec into a Task Checklist.
Follow for a new short every day and learn to build with AI the right way.

comment: Build command or style rule: which goes first in your AGENTS.md? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: write each rule as a short command, like Test: npm test, so the agent can copy it exactly.
